```python
import openmobisim as ms
import pandas as pd

run = ms.examples.case("delft").scenario("base").run("delft-base")
timings = run.timings().to_pandas()
by_stage = timings[timings["stage"] != "total"].groupby("stage")["seconds"].sum()
by_stage.sort_values(ascending=False).round(2).head(8)
```
